messages.content: Predict one person's actual joint strategy-form submission. In each situation four members each have a fresh 20 monetary units (MU) and choose an integer contribution from 0 to 20 MU to a public project. Uncontributed units remain private. The sum of all four contributions is multiplied by 1.6 and shared equally: your payoff(MU)=20−your contribution+0.4×the sum of all four contributions. Separate situations each have their own 20 MU budget. 1 MU converts to CHF0.05, with a CHF10 show-up fee; payment is at the end. Choices are anonymous and communication is prohibited. The form simultaneously covers two separate situations: you with three real people, and you with three virtual computer members whose contributions are independently random. Only you are human and receive cash in the virtual group. For each situation enter one unconditional contribution, without knowing others' contributions, and a conditional contribution for each hypothetical rounded mean contribution of the other three: 0,1,...,20 MU. These are hypothetical conditions, not observed partner choices. In the real group randomly choose one of four people to implement the conditional schedule; the other three use unconditional contributions. The selected schedule is indexed by the rounded mean of the other three unconditional contributions. Your selection probability is 1/4. In the computer situation your conditional schedule is used with probability 1/4 and your unconditional choice with probability 3/4. Each situation has a fresh 20 MU; do not sum all 44 entries to a shared 20 MU. Both situations are confirmed together on one form and are binding paid choices. Current real/computer realizations are not yet revealed; earnings are revealed at the end. Output only one JSON object with fixed keys human_unconditional,human_conditional,computer_unconditional,computer_conditional; each conditional array has 21 integers ordered by hypothetical others' mean 0 through 20, and each unconditional value is an integer 0 through 20.

Predict one person's current actual choice in a public goods experiment. In each situation four members each have a fresh 20 monetary units (MU) and choose an integer contribution from 0 to 20 MU to a public project. Uncontributed units remain private. The sum of all four contributions is multiplied by 1.6 and shared equally: your payoff(MU)=20−your contribution+0.4×the sum of all four contributions. Separate situations each have their own 20 MU budget. 1 MU converts to CHF0.05, with a CHF10 show-up fee; payment is at the end. Choices are anonymous and communication is prohibited. You contribute over six rounds with the same three other members, with a fresh 20 MU each round. During these rounds you see neither your own round earnings nor your groupmates' contributions or earnings. You receive only the specified information from a separate completed experiment. That earlier experiment had 20 people in 5 groups making 0–20 MU contributions; its data are not your current group's behavior. After each contribution you and your group receive the previous experiment's mean contribution of all 20 people and the mean contribution of the five lowest contributors, one per group, rounded to integers. The present target is this round's contribution. Output only one integer 0 through 20,in MU.
